data.title: Home help request rejected by Muster BKK
data.summary: Muster BKK rejected your request for home help (Haushaltshilfe) during your hospital stay, because no child under 12 lives in your household and its statutes offer no wider benefits. You may file an objection within one month of notification.
data.explanation: Your health insurer decided that you are not entitled to home help under § 38 SGB V. It says home help needs a child under 12 in the household, or a statute rule that goes further, and neither applies. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person for the record. Send it to Muster BKK at the address given. The app shows the deadline. If you do nothing, the rejection becomes final. A social counselling service or a lawyer can help if you are unsure.

items.title: File objection against rejection
items.action: If you disagree, file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or for the record with Muster BKK, Beispielweg 1, 34117 Neu-Musterdorf.
items.consequence: Without an objection in time, the rejection becomes final.
